payload.text:
# Provider and model configuration for the prompt-optimization harness.
# Every run freezes a copy of this file into its inputs; edit here, not in Python.

[hosts]
ollama = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
openrouter = "https://openrouter.ai"

[local]
# Ollama tags screened by preflight. Each installed tag yields thinking-off and thinking-on
# conditions ("<tag>/off", "<tag>/on") when the model reports the thinking capability.
tags = [
  "qwen3.8:27b",
  "granite4.2:30b",
  "gemma4:31b",
  "muse-glimmer:latest",
  "nemotron-3.5-lightning:30b",
]

[hosted]
# OpenRouter model IDs and the pinned endpoint tag for each. Endpoints must support
# response_format, structured_outputs and reasoning; a run refuses an endpoint whose
# tariff rises above the frozen price unless the increase is accepted explicitly.
models = ["deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro", "z-ai/glm-5.3", "anthropic/claude-opus-5"]

[hosted.endpoints]
"deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro" = "streamlake/fp8"
"z-ai/glm-5.3" = "reka/fp8"
"anthropic/claude-opus-5" = "anthropic"

[calibration]
# Local conditions screened by the calibration gate and the hosted decidability reference.
conditions = [
  "qwen3.8:27b/off",
  "qwen3.8:27b/on",
  "gemma4:31b/off",
  "gemma4:31b/on",
  "muse-glimmer:latest/on",
  "granite4.2:30b/off",
]
reference = "deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro"

[ablation]
# Executors for the fixed scaffolding controls; must equal the gate-promoted pair.
executors = ["qwen3.8:27b/off", "granite4.2:30b/off"]
